flow.name: inventory-items-get-flow
flow.doc:description: Without ids lists the inventory by page; with ids returns up to 100 items with their providers

choice.doc:description: With ids it is the batch lookup with providers

db:select.doc:description: Items whose ids are in the list (unknown ids are left out)
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ID, SKU, NAME, STOCK_QTY, LOCAL_PRICE, CURRENCY FROM INVENTORY WHERE INSTR(',' || :ids || ',', ',' || ID || ',') > 0 ORDER BY SKU

db:select.doc:description: Providers of those items with their last price
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ITEM_ID, PROVIDER_ABV, EXTERNAL_ID, IS_PREFERRED, LAST_PRICE, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(LAST_PRICE_AT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS LAST_PRICE_AT FROM INVENTORY_PROVIDERS WHERE INSTR(',' || :ids || ',', ',' || ITEM_ID || ',') > 0 ORDER BY ITEM_ID, PROVIDER_ABV

ee:transform.doc:description: Items with their providers and the preferred one flagged

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toInventoryItems from modules::erp output application/json --- toInventoryItems(vars.itemRows, payload)

db:select.doc:description: One inventory page sorted by SKU
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ID, SKU, NAME, STOCK_QTY, LOCAL_PRICE, CURRENCY FROM INVENTORY ORDER BY SKU OFFSET :pageOffset ROWS FETCH NEXT :pageSize ROWS ONLY

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toInventoryItems from modules::erp output application/json --- toInventoryItems(payload, null)

flow.name: inventory-movements-post-flow
flow.doc:description: Registers an outbound or restock movement once per reference; an outbound above stock returns 409

set-variable.doc:description: Negative for an outbound movement, positive for a restock

db:select.doc:description: Looks for a movement already registered with the same reference
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ID, ITEM_ID, MOVEMENT_TYPE, QTY, REFERENCE, ORDER_ID, RESULTING_STOCK, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(CREATED_AT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS CREATED_AT FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS WHERE REFERENCE = :reference

choice.doc:description: A repeated reference returns the original movement without moving stock

otherwise.doc:description: Moves the stock and registers the movement

try.doc:description: If another request registered the same reference at the same time, the original is returned
Stock and movement together: both or neither

db:update.doc:description: Adds to or subtracts from stock; Oracle rejects negative stock
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE INVENTORY SET STOCK_QTY = STOCK_QTY + :delta WHERE ID = :itemId

choice.doc:description: No updated rows means the item does not exist

when.doc:description: The item is not in INVENTORY

db:select.db:sql: SELECT STOCK_QTY FROM INVENTORY WHERE ID = :itemId

set-variable.doc:description: Movement with its id and the resulting stock
set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { ID: uuid(), ITEM_ID: vars.movement.itemId, MOVEMENT_TYPE: vars.movement.'type', QTY: vars.movement.quantity, REFERENCE: vars.movement.reference, ORDER_ID: vars.movement.orderId, RESULTING_STOCK: payload[0].STOCK_QTY as Number, CREATED_AT: (now() >> 'UTC') as String {format: 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'} }]

db:insert.doc:description: Inserts the movement; the reference is unique
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS (ID, ITEM_ID, MOVEMENT_TYPE, QTY, REFERENCE, ORDER_ID, RESULTING_STOCK) VALUES (:id, :itemId, :movementType, :qty, :reference, :orderId, :resultingStock)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { id: vars.newMovement.ID, itemId: vars.newMovement.ITEM_ID, movementType: vars.newMovement.MOVEMENT_TYPE, qty: vars.newMovement.QTY, reference: vars.newMovement.REFERENCE, orderId: vars.newMovement.ORDER_ID, resultingStock: vars.newMovement.RESULTING_STOCK }]

on-error-propagate.doc:description: The outbound movement would leave negative stock

raise-error.description: The outbound movement would leave negative stock

on-error-propagate.doc:description: Another request registered the same reference: this attempt is rolled back

raise-error.doc:description: Caught outside to return the original

on-error-propagate.doc:description: The movement orderId does not exist

raise-error.description: The movement order does not exist

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toMovement from modules::erp output application/json --- toMovement(vars.newMovement)

on-error-continue.doc:description: Stock did not move twice: returns the movement that won

db:select.doc:description: Reads the movement registered by the other request
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ID, ITEM_ID, MOVEMENT_TYPE, QTY, REFERENCE, ORDER_ID, RESULTING_STOCK, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(CREATED_AT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS CREATED_AT FROM INVENTORY_MOVEMENTS WHERE REFERENCE = :reference

sub-flow.name: movement-existing-response-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Returns 200 with the already registered movement (first payload row)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toMovement from modules::erp output application/json --- toMovement(payload[0])
